audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was 'Skill' in both layers; the already-audited Sejuani side gives that row to Sejuani.
audit.why: Glacial Prison is a 1300-range projectile stun that also reveals stealth. Vayne has no way to refuse it at that range and no cleanse in kit, so the level-6 row is his. Every other row stays Vayne, consistent with 51.3% over 540 games.
audit.corrected: Vayne, Vayne, Vayne, Vayne, Sejuani, Vayne, Vayne — proposed as a matched full/content pair.
sources: kit: Glacial Prison 1300 range, hardCC, revealsStealth

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 lines credited Final Hour with breaking her pattern; the ultimate that decides level 6 is hers.
audit.why: Final Hour is 100/85/70s and roughly halves Tumble's 6/5/4/3/2s cooldown while making each cast invisible — but Glacial Prison reveals stealth, so the spike is conditional on her 120/105/90s ult being spent.
audit.corrected: Your two-item window is the real spike; at 6 fight only after Glacial Prison is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three lines called the slow 'Permafrost'. Permafrost (E) is the 1.5s-cooldown stun that only fires at maximum Frost stacks; the slow and the Frost stacks come from Winter's Wrath (W), 9/8/7/6/5s. Nothing anywhere recorded that Glacial Prison reveals stealth.
audit.why: Riot's text: Winter's Wrath 'slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks'; Permafrost 'freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks'. Glacial Prison carries revealsStealth, and Final Hour's Tumble invisibility is Vayne's only stealth — so her ult answers the escape, not only the engage. Silver Bolts' true damage ignores Frost Armor's armour and MR outright.
audit.corrected: Dodge Winter's Wrath and Permafrost has nothing to stun with; Glacial Prison reveals your Final Hour Tumbles.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Winter's Wrath is the enabler on 9s at rank 1 and Arctic Assault her only gap-closer at 18s rank 1 — both give a concrete 'fight after X' window.
audit.corrected: Commit while Winter's Wrath is on its 9 seconds; without Frost stacks the E cannot stun.

edits.after: Glacial Prison reveals stealth over 1300 units, so it strips Final Hour's invisible Tumbles and stuns you. Do not fight into it at 6.
